integrity: Mathematical proof supplied; finite computations are auxiliary, not a proof for all graphs. Priority beyond examined literature is unverified; independent audit not performed.
scientific_limitations: Two unordered particles on finite connected simple graphs; exchange-sign integral local system only. The divided square is the invariant integral lattice, not the symmetric coinvariant lattice. Does not determine ordinary singular homology, higher-particle twists, or arbitrary coefficients.
title: Exchange-sign Borel–Moore homology of two-point graph configurations
